title: Angular Momentum of a Bicycle Wheel
body: A mountain biker takes a jump in a race and goes airborne. The mountain bike is travelling at $$10.0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$ before it goes airborne. The mass of the front wheel on the bike is $$750\, \text{g}$$ and has radius $$35\, \text{cm}$$ (model the wheel as a hoop, $$I=mr**{2})$$.
